New native commits carry the native Origin trailer and must never be added here.

rekey_note: Re-keyed by HQ seat-48 attribution gap-fix (gap G1 of registers/2026-08-29-release-attribution-audit.md). The 2026-08-29 base moves (b10524 -> b10636 -> b10680) rebased arifi/main and rewrote every sha, leaving 0 of 289 ledger shas resolvable. Re-keyed by exact-subject match against arifi/main: 289 of 289 matched exactly once, 0 ambiguous, 0 unmatched. Prior keys retained in 'sha_pre_rebase' - append, not overwrite. CAVEAT: this restored the KEY only. It did NOT re-validate the 'fork-authored, no upstream origin exists' classification in 'purpose'. Gap G12 of the same audit reports 180 of these 289 carry patch-filename subjects naming ports and upstream PR numbers; that re-audit is OUTSTANDING and needs the President's word. reaudit_2026_08_29: G12 RE-AUDIT, PARTIAL. 180 of the 289 have a patch-filename subject.
